question: 华东区域不同支付方式的24年12月31日退款率分布情况
gold_sql: select o.pay_type, count(distinct re.refund_id) * 1.0 / count(distinct o.order_id) from orders o join users u on o.user_id = u.user_id join regions r on u.region_id = r.region_id left join refunds re on o.order_id = re.order_id and re.refund_time >= '2024-12-31' and re.refund_time < '2025-01-01' where r.region_name = '华东' group by o.pay_type
raw_output:
SELECT d.pay_type,
       COALESCE(rf.refund_amount, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.total_amount, 0) AS refund_rate
FROM (
    SELECT o.pay_type, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM orders o
    JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
    JOIN regions rg ON u.region_id = rg.region_id
    WHERE rg.region_name = '华东'
      AND substr(o.order_time, 1, 10) = '2024-12-31'
      AND o.status IN ('已完成', '已退款')
    GROUP BY o.pay_type
) d
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT o.pay_type, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM orders o
    JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
    JOIN regions rg ON u.region_id = rg.region_id
    JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id AND r.status = '已退款'
    WHERE rg.region_name = '华东'
      AND substr(o.order_time, 1, 10) = '2024-12-31'
      AND o.status IN ('已完成', '已退款')
    GROUP BY o.pay_type
) rf ON d.pay_type = rf.pay_type;
